# Version 3.118.0
> **Engine refresh and WebAssembly compatibility** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/3.118.0-preview.2.3)

> **Superseded by [3.119.0](3.119.0.md)** · Never released as stable — these changes rolled up into 3.119.0.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](3.118.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.1/index.md)

## Highlights

The 3.118 previews advance to Skia m118 and improve .NET 9 WebAssembly compatibility. Android native assets gain 16 KB alignment, and Metal backend render-target APIs become available across platforms.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia m118 renderer** — Updates the bundled engine through milestones 117 and 118, with matching managed and native bindings. ([#3047](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3047), [#3048](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3048))

## Bug Fixes

- **WebAssembly imports and .NET 9 startup** — Fixes .NET 9 Blazor issues, extends the WASM workaround to applications that do not reference Blazor views, and corrects imports when an application uses a base path. ([#3064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3064), [#3082](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3082), [#3088](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3088), [#3092](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3092))
- **Native asset package paths** — Corrects the PackagePath attribute used to place packaged assets. ([#3101](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3101))

## Platform

- **Android 16 KB alignment** — Moves Android native builds to NDK r27c and 16 KB page alignment. ([#3099](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3099))

## API Surface

- **Cross-platform Metal render-target bindings** — Makes the Metal API on GRBackendRenderTarget available across all platforms. — ❤️ [@spouliot](https://github.com/spouliot) ([#3070](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3070))

## Security

- **Bundled dependency refresh** — Updates libexpat to 2.6.4 and FreeType to the 2.13.3-based revision, and refreshes the libjpeg-turbo 2.1.5.1-based dependency. ([#3056](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3056), [#3061](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3061), [#3060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3060))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1

HarfBuzzSharp receives Android 16 KB alignment and package-path corrections. WASM workaround changes also cover consumers outside the Blazor views package.
